deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the stained slice through a tumour illustrates tumour explantation ('illustrates this'), linking the image to the previous sentence. The lecturer merely introduces the image to show tumour morphology, without stating that it illustrates explanting.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like, biologists are studying tumors
considerations.reason: The introductory phrases 'So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like' are spoken filler and were appropriately omitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: try to get them to grow in culture
considerations.reason: Replacing the pronoun 'them' with 'the cells' is an allowed clarification based directly on the immediate context ('individual tumor cells').

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: Omitting 'really' in 'Primary cells do not grow in culture' is allowed because 'really' was used as conversational emphasis rather than a scientific hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is a remark to the audience / personal aside and was rightly omitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Changing 'other things' to 'other components' is an allowed stylistic variation with equivalent meaning.
